Hi all —

Attached are the artifacts requested: redwood-subprocessors-20270714.csv (manifest) and edgeconnector-decom-plan.pdf (decommission timeline & temporary routing). Summary below.

Executive summary:
- EdgeConnector v1 is scheduled for rollout retirement on 2027-08-01 (non-optional). Traffic will be migrated to EdgeConnector v2 and CloudRelay Inc (temporary relay) during a staged cutover window.
- Subprocessors in the EdgeConnector pipeline (short list):
  * CloudRelay Inc — temporary relay; US/CA processing; has access to routed telemetry (no customer content persisted)
  * TelemetryX (EU) — metrics collection; does not persist raw content; EU residency enforced for EU-tagged tenants
  * ArchiveWorks — long-term retention for customer logs (US-based; access restricted to scrubbed aggregates)
  * CDNFlow Partners — edge caching; may operate in multiple regions per customer routing rules

Cross-border / onshore fallback notes:
- For EU customers, we will route through TelemetryX EU nodes and maintain onshore fallback for critical telemetry during cutover.
- For US customers, CloudRelay Inc will be used as a short-term bridge; CloudRelay has a signed DPA (SOC 2 Type II) — evidence is on our secure drive (link below).

Attachments included: redwood-subprocessors-20270714.csv (CSV manifest with columns: subprocessor_name, role, country, access_level, evidence_link), edgeconnector-decom-plan.pdf (cutover windows and rollback steps).

Drive evidence: https://drive.redwood.example.com/secure/FinFirm/SOC2/2027-evidence

Next steps for FinFirm: confirm whether temporary use of CloudRelay Inc is acceptable for their audit (CloudRelay does handle telemetry only and is covered by our DPA). We can provide a signed DPA addendum via DocuSign if required.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
